ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-onboarding screening against the VFSC consolidated watchlist, Vanuatu domestic sanctions designations, United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, OFAC SDN list, EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists, INTERPOL notices, adverse media, and recognized global PEP databases. Enhanced due diligence, including source-of-wealth verification and senior management approval, is required for any politically exposed person, family member, or close associate; negative screening results must be documented and retained by the licensed registered agent.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Office — online name search, reservation, and incorporation filing via the VFSC e-Services portal at https://www.vfsc.vu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names may be registered in English, French, Bislama, or any language using the Latin alphabet; official statutory records are maintained in English, with French as an official language for alternative submissions; names must contain the suffix 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Société Anonyme', or the French equivalent as statutorily recognized, and must be phonetically and visually distinguishable from existing registered names.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant's licensed registered agent must file a written reconsideration request with the VFSC Companies Office within 14 calendar days, specifying why the proposed name satisfies statutory distinctiveness and is not prohibited; the VFSC must respond within 21 calendar days; if the rejection is confirmed, the applicant may pursue an administrative appeal to the Minister responsible for finance or judicial review by originating application in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu; a new reservation application may be filed simultaneously using a revised name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A Vanuatu International Company must at all times maintain a registered office in Vanuatu through a licensed registered agent; a virtual office is permissible for the day-to-day operations of a low-risk digital UI/UX design subscription agency, provided the statutory registered office and registered agent address remain the exclusive legal address for service of process and statutory notices.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — estimated annual probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection is below 5% for a non-regulated, offshore-only design-subscription vehicle; compliance examination is conducted primarily through desk-based VFSC AML/CFT and beneficial-ownership file reviews plus licensed registered-agent record audits.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 2007 (Act No. 5 of 2007), ss. 8-20 (incorporation), s. 21 (registered office), ss. 33-44 (directors and officers); Companies Act [Cap. 191] as residual guide
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Registrar of International Companies, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 - Application for Registration of an International Company, followed by issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an International Company; authorized share capital is set in the Memorandum, no escrow account or capital deposit with VFSC is required
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the subscribers' share subscriptions set out in the Statement of Application are accepted, the initial shares are allotted, issued, and recorded in the register of members as fully or partly paid under the International Companies Act 2007, and the Company adopts its Memorandum and Articles of Association as filed. RESOLVED: That the registered office of the Company in Vanuatu is fixed at the principal office of the licensed registered agent, Port Vila, Vanuatu, and that agent is retained. RESOLVED: That [Director Name] is appointed sole director, [Officer Name] is appointed company secretary, and they are authorized, jointly or singly, to open bank accounts, execute agreements, and file all necessary returns.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Registry; filing via VFSC-licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed company names to the licensed registered agent for a VFSC name-priority check. The name must end with 'Limited' and must not be misleading or identical to an existing registered entity.
required_dossiers: Proposed name clause of the Memorandum
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or reserved for another applicant, submit two alternative names; VFSC generally re-adjudicates within 1-2 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association under the International Companies Act 2007, sets authorized share capital, subscribes shares, and arranges witnessed execution by the subscriber(s).
required_dossiers: Statement of Subscribers and Share Allotment
Certified passport copies and proof of address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries drafting or capital clauses, counsel amends and re-executes a conformed copy within two business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Application for Registration of an International Company (Form 1), attach the constitutional documents, and lodge with the VFSC together with the prescribed government filing fee through the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Subscriber statement and share allotment summary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or returned, respond in writing to VFSC within 10 business days with corrected filings; VFSC may otherwise treat the application as abandoned.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Company Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon acceptance, VFSC registers the company, assigns a registration number, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation and public extract. Verify all corporate particulars against the statutory filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the certificate contains clerical errors, file a rectification request with supporting evidence; VFSC may issue an amended certificate within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of Registered Office and First Board Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting to adopt the pro forma board resolutions, confirm the registered office at the agent's address in Port Vila, appoint directors and secretary, open statutory registers, and approve bank signatories.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Not applicable - board minutes may be signed in counterpart; procedural defects are cured by unanimous written resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Beneficial Ownership, AML/KYC and Annual Compliance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU); licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File beneficial ownership particulars with the registered agent for the VFSC beneficial ownership register, complete customer due diligence, adopt a simplified AML policy, and calendarize annual return and renewal fee dates.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the FIU or VFSC challenge the ownership information, update the register and file a revised declaration within 14 days.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no physical works, construction, or discharge; virtual service-only business
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharge or VOC emission sources; digital service generates zero effluent; if an administrative office is later leased, domestic waste handling will follow the Waste Management Act [Cap. 260] thresholds

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for registered-office-only operations; if a physical office is later opened in Vanuatu, obtain municipal occupancy permit, fire safety clearance from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services, and workplace safety inspection from the Department of Labour

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Customs and Inland Revenue Department (CIRD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Government of Vanuatu, operating the national CIRD Taxpayer Online Services portal for VAT registration and filing; corporate incorporation and tax-exempt certification for International Companies are administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: (1) Incorporate the International Company (VU_IC) with VFSC and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation and VFSC Registration Number. (2) Confirm statutory income-tax exemption: Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, inheritance tax, or dividend withholding tax; accordingly, no income-tax TIN is issued to ICs. (3) If the IC makes or intends to make taxable supplies exceeding the VAT threshold (VT 5,000,000 in any rolling 12-month period), file VAT registration with CIRD within 21 days of becoming liable and obtain the 9-digit VAT Registration Number, which serves as the sole fiscal identifier for indirect tax purposes. (4) For a pure export-subscription model where all UI/UX design subscription clients are non-residents, supplies are zero-rated and net VAT is nil; voluntary VAT registration remains advisable solely to recover input VAT on local operational costs (bank fees, hosting, legal). (5) Open a foreign-currency bank account (USD/AUD) with a licensed Vanuatu bank and comply with the bank's AML/KYC controls; no exchange-control approval is required for ICs dealing in foreign currency under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 65], as amended by the International Companies Act. (6) Maintain the VFSC annual license fee (VT 18,000 to VT 78,000 depending on amount of nominal capital), being the only recurring 'tax-like' impost on an IC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists or is necessary because Vanuatu imposes no income tax regime and the IC is automatically and mandatorily tax-exempt. Under the Value Added Tax Act No. 5 of 2023, the only available procedural mechanisms are: (i) voluntary VAT registration for a business making exclusively zero-rated export supplies, to recover input VAT on local costs; (ii) Commissioner-directed tax periods (monthly for large taxpayers, quarterly or other period as prescribed) rather than taxpayer-elected periods; and (iii) no domestic hybrid-mismatch rules apply, Vanuatu not having enacted the OECD Hybrid Mismatch Report. No CFC, thin-capitalization, or transfer-pricing adjustment provisions are in force in Vanuatu.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 5 of 2023, effective 1 July 2023, administered by CIRD and replacing the former Turnover Tax regime.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 (approximately USD 42,000) of taxable turnover in any rolling 12-month period; zero-rated exported services are takable into account for threshold purposes, so a high-revenue export-only design subscription IC is registrable but has nil net VAT liability, while a wholly local-facing business above the threshold is compulsorily registrable at 15% standard rate.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, government API e-invoicing, or digital-stamping mandate exists in Vanuatu. VAT invoices may be issued in paper or electronic (PDF/PDF-based billing systems) form and must contain the prescribed particulars under section 30 of the VAT Act (supplier name, address and VAT registration number; invoice date and number; recipient name and address; description and quantity of supply; net amount; VAT rate; VAT amount; total payable; and currency). VAT returns and payments are submitted through the CIRD online portal by the 25th day of the month following the end of the tax period, with no third-party clearance or approval node. Stripe Billing and Wise payment records serve as commercial and FX evidence but are not subject to fiscal pre-clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to: (i) exported goods supported by customs export documentation; and (ii) supplies of services to a recipient who is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply and who does not acquire the services for use in Vanuatu (export of services) under section 15 and Schedule 2 of the VAT Act 2023. For the ISIC 7410 UI/UX design subscription business, each subscription invoice to a non-resident client qualifies as a zero-rated exported service provided the IC retains proof of the recipient's non-resident status, the design deliverables are digitally delivered and consumed abroad, and the subscription is billed and paid in foreign currency from outside Vanuatu; supplies to Vanuatu-resident persons or enterprises, or services used in Vanuatu, are standard-rated at 15%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Zero-rated VAT invoice containing all statutory particulars and annotated 'Export / Zero-Rated'
Customs Export Declaration (required only for physical goods; for digital design subscriptions, retain the electronic delivery log and download record instead)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (applicable only where physical deliverables or branded collateral are shipped; not applicable to pure SaaS/digital delivery)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank/Stripe Billing/Wise statement evidencing receipt of payment from the foreign counterparty in foreign currency
Signed Subscription Agreement, Master Services Agreement or Statement of Work confirming offshore client, scope, and digital delivery jurisdiction
Evidence of client non-residency (foreign certificate of incorporation, overseas tax/VAT registration number, registered office address, or passport copy)
Annual VAT Return and subscription billing ledger demonstrating that all supplies were made to non-residents and that no supply was made to a person present in Vanuatu
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: CIRD may reopen past VAT returns within the applicable statutory reassessment window and may reclassify any zero-rated supply as standard-rated where exporter status or offshore use is not substantiated. Negligent under-charge attracts a penalty of up to 200% of the tax undercharged plus interest at 1% per month; fraudulent evasion, including issuing false zero-rated invoices, is a criminal offence punishable by fines of up to VT 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment of up to 2 years under sections 61 to 63 of the VAT Act 2023. The Commissioner may cancel VAT registration, and VFSC may revoke the International Company's certificate under section 73 of the International Companies Act, causing forfeiture of tax-exempt privileges and compulsory winding-up. Although the Exchange Control Act imposes no statutory 180-day repatriation deadline on ICs, CIRD applies the 180-day inward-remittance benchmark as a documentary condition; failure to evidence receipt of export proceeds within 180 days from invoice date raises a rebuttable presumption that the supply was domestic, triggering retrospective clawback of the zero-rating together with penalties and interest.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) with supervisory coordination by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for International Companies
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is fully convertible for current-account transactions and, for International Companies (ICs), capital-account transactions are liberalised without RBV exchange-control approval. Profit, dividend, and liquidation proceeds may be remitted freely to non-residents; ICs are statutorily exempt from income, corporate, capital gains, and withholding taxes under the International Companies Act (CAP 222). VUV is administratively pegged to a trade-weighted basket of AUD, NZD, USD, EUR, and JPY. Practical friction is confined to a thin local interbank FX market, wide VUV/USD spreads, and dependence on Australian/NZ correspondent clearing; no material profit-remittance hurdle exists in law or regulation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None imposed. The RBV does not mandate surrender, conversion, retention, or a statutory timeline for export receipts derived from digital design subscription services. An IC may retain 100% of export proceeds in VUV or any freely convertible foreign currency account (FCA) at a licensed commercial bank, subject only to balance-of-payments statistical reporting by the receiving bank.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Foreign Currency Account (VUV/USD/AUD) with Capital Escrow Facility

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of the South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Moderate feasibility for offshore digital EMIs. Vanuatu has no domestic EMI licensing regime; unlicensed foreign EMIs may not hold VUV balances or clear through the Vanuatu National Payment System. Wise Business and similar payout rails are viable as payment-acceptance and disbursement channels for subscription receivables, while US/EU business EMIs (e.g., Mercury, Airwallex) generally decline or heavily restrict VU International Companies due to sanctions-screening and de-risking policy; onboarding success requires a VFSC-licensed registered agent referral, economic-substance evidence, and a minimum 3-month transaction-flow projection.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance by directors is not a statutory precondition; ANZ and BSP permit remote account opening when the application is submitted through a VFSC-licensed registered agent with certified-true copies of passports, proof of address, constitutive documents, and a UBO register extraction. A live video KYC interview with each beneficial owner is mandatory where the bank MLRO determines enhanced due diligence; a physical Port Vila branch appearance may be substituted at bank discretion for grey-list or higher-risk profiles.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident International Company with nominee shareholder and no demonstrable economic substance flagged as offshore shell risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, current Directors and Members Register, signed UBO declaration, registered-agent engagement letter, International Companies (Amendment) Act 2020 economic-substance declaration, office lease or virtual-office services agreement, payroll records for local subcontractors, and an operational business plan with subscription revenue projections.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of funds for initial capital injection and pre-revenue subscription deposits
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution authorising the capital injection, shareholder subscription receipts, prior 3-month source account statements, Stripe Billing and Wise payout statements evidencing client subscription inflows, signed UI/UX design subscription client agreements, founder source-of-wealth questionnaire, and an independent CPA comfort letter as to fund origin.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, and high-risk client-country mismatches in cross-border SaaS/design subscription receivables
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed sanctions-screening exception report, PEP self-declaration, negative-media report for each UBO, domain and IP registration proof, client-country AML risk matrix, real-time transaction-monitoring workflow, and data-processing agreements allocating KYC/CDD responsibility between the IC and its payment processors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Correspondent-bank de-risking anxiety over the VUV corridor and Vanuatu offshore-sector reputation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sponsor introduction letter from the VFSC-licensed registered agent, minimum-balance and full-transparency covenant letter, annual anti-money-laundering and CTF audit certificate from an approved Vanuatu firm, IC tax and AML penalty-free history, and an updated FATF/EU list-status memorandum contextualising Vanuatu offshore regulation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound funds must be transmitted by SWIFT MT103 (or ISO 20022 pacs.008) with a clearly stated purpose reference such as Equity Injection, Intercompany Loan, or Digital Design Subscription Revenue. No RBV prior approval is required for IC capital inflows; receiving institutions file the balance-of-payments report with the RBV. The remitting party must be the ultimate creditor or subscription client in its own name - third-party aggregators are rejected. ANZ and BSP apply T+1 value dating via Australian/US nostro accounts; any injection above USD 100,000 or VUV 10,000,000 must be evidenced on file by a board resolution, subscription agreement, and source-of-funds documentation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rails are SWIFT MT103 for subcontractor and software-licence disbursements, MT700 (sight/confirmed) Commercial Letters of Credit for procurement of design infrastructure, MT202 for nostro replenishment, and same-day VUV settlement through the RBV-operated Vanuatu Clearing House for local disbursements. USD/AUD clearing is effected via ANZ Sydney and BSP Brisbane/Port Moresby correspondents; EUR clearing via BRED Bank Paris. Every disbursement requires an invoice, statement of work, sanctions and ownership screening, and a three-day pre-payment review by the treasury function.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable VUV/USD and VUV/AUD outright forward contracts (10-day to 12-month tenors) provided by ANZ Vanuatu or BSP against contracted commercial exposure

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/VUV referencing the RBV published mid-rate, executed by Singapore, Hong Kong, or Australian wholesale desks to hedge balance-sheet exposure without physical VUV delivery
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps (CCIRS) in USD/VUV for intercompany loan and equity exposure hedges with no speculative intent
Zero-cost collar and vanilla FX option strategies permitted under the IC treasury mandate for revenue-conversion floor protection
Natural hedge strategy denominating subscription receivables and vendor payables in USD/AUD to minimise VUV conversion requirement

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registrar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 calendar days after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of up to VT 15,000; continued non-filing for 6 months triggers notice of proposed strike-off; company may be dissolved after 3 months of unresolved delinquency.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Registered Agent Concurs and Standing Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent (on behalf of VFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with Annual Return filing, usually due 30 days before the statutory deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent results in automatic administrative strike-off and forfeiture of assets to the Government of Vanuatu.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit applies to Vanuatu International Companies under the International Companies Act; audits are required only if the board or VFSC determines exceptional need, or if the company elects to file audited financial statements for banking or counterparty purposes.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as permitted by the International Companies Act; no local GAAP is prescribed for International Companies. Non-mandatory management accounts are accepted.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Annual Return must confirm the registered shareholding structure and identify all directors and shareholders. Transfers of shares are recorded in the Register of Members, and the registered agent must annually confirm that the company's register reflects all share transfers and that the ultimate beneficial owner details, if collected, remain current. Public disclosure of UBO information is not required.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 – USD 750 per annum for licensed agent and registered office services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 800 – USD 2,000 only if audited financial statements are voluntarily requested; not required for ordinary International Company maintenance

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: A Vanuatu International Company ('IC') is wholly outside the Vanuatu domestic income tax net. The International Companies Act (Cap. 222) exempts an IC from all Vanuatu national taxes in perpetuity, including corporate income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax on dividends/interest/royalties, and stamp duty. The only recurrent statutory charge is the annual VFSC registration fee (currently approximately VUV 25,000, or roughly USD 200, plus the licensed registered agent's professional fee). Domestic VAT at 12.5% applies exclusively to local supplies of goods and services in Vanuatu and does not attach to offshore UI/UX design-subscription revenue invoiced and delivered from outside Vanuatu.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return - Form AR/IC (Annual Return for International Companies), filed through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission ('VFSC') electronic filing portal at https://www.vfsc.vu; the annual registration fee is remitted concurrently with the filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing is due no later than one calendar month after each anniversary of the date of incorporation; the annual fee invoice must be settled by the same date to avoid late penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered company name and certificate of incorporation number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the name exactly as it appears on the VFSC certificate of incorporation; any trading-name variant used for the design-subscription service is disclosed separately to the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office and licensed registered agent in Vanuatu (physical street address, postal address, and agent licence number).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The address must be a physical Vanuatu address maintained by the licensed agent; a post-office box alone is insufficient for statutory service of process.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors: full legal name, residential and business address, date of birth, nationality, and occupation. A minimum of one director is required.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are expressly permitted; submit certified passport copies and proof of residential address. Corporate directors are permitted unless the Memorandum and Articles of Association provide otherwise.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shareholder schedule showing issued shares, share classes, consideration paid, and transfer history.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders may hold 100% of the issued capital. The registered shareholder and the ultimate beneficial owner may differ only where the licensed agent maintains the separate statutory Beneficial Ownership Register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, nominal currency denomination, and any restrictions on transfers or special rights attached to share classes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the capital in the currency elected in the Memorandum of Association; there is no minimum capital requirement for an IC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory declaration of continuing compliance: confirmation that the IC has not contravened the International Companies Act and that the registered office and agent remain engaged.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The declaration is signed by a director or by the registered agent under a standing authority; knowingly false declarations attract criminal liability.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a late-payment penalty plus a per-day surcharge on the unpaid annual fee under the operative VFSC fee schedule; persistent non-filing results in administrative strike-off and loss of limited-liability status under the International Companies Act. Officer-level contraventions of the Act carry fines of up to VUV 500,000 and imprisonment of up to six months. Reinstatement after strike-off is discretionary and requires payment of all arrears, penalties, and reinstatement fees.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Beneficial Ownership Return ('BOR') - required by the Beneficial Ownership Act 2020 (No. 29 of 2020), lodged through the licensed registered agent and accessible to VFSC through the integrated VFSC electronic register.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual confirmation plus event-driven updates; any change in ownership must be lodged within 14 days of the triggering event.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual BOR confirmation is due contemporaneously with the VFSC Annual Return, i.e., within one month of each incorporation anniversary; changes in a 25%-or-greater beneficial interest are due within 14 days of the transaction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal entity details of the IC: registered name, registration number, date of incorporation, registered office, and principal place of business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The principal place of business may be outside Vanuatu; identify the controlling jurisdiction in which the UI/UX subscription contracts are negotiated and delivered.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ultimate beneficial owner ('UBO') identification: full legal name, nationality, date of birth, residential address, and tax identification number in the country of tax residence.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The UBO is any natural person who ultimately owns or controls 25% or more of the shares, 25% or more of the voting rights, or who exercises control by other means; all layers of intermediate corporate ownership must be traced to a natural person.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Nature and extent of the beneficial interest: percentage of issued shares, percentage of voting rights, and the control mechanism by which the UBO exercises influence.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Where control arises through a nominee shareholder or a trust, annex the nominee declaration or trust deed; the underlying natural person remains registrable as UBO.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Supporting due-diligence and source-of-funds documentation: certified passport, proof of address, narrative of fund origin, and commercial rationale for the recurring design-subscription model.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Documents must be in English or accompanied by a certified translation; AML/KYC records are held by the licensed agent and are lawfully accessible by VFSC and Vanuatu law-enforcement authorities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to lodge or update the BOR is an offence under the Beneficial Ownership Act 2020: corporate fines of up to VUV 500,000 and director-level fines of up to VUV 1,000,000 with imprisonment of up to two years; VFSC may additionally refuse the annual return, suspend the IC's registration, and apply for judicial strike-off.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax by law, and no domestic DTA relief mechanism is required for distributions made by an IC from Vanuatu. Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double tax treaty network; its cooperation instruments are Tax Information Exchange Agreements and the OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance. Where a foreign recipient requires a Vanuatu certificate of fiscal residence to claim credit or exemption abroad, the application is submitted to the Vanuatu International Taxation and Investment Authority ('ITIA'), supported by evidence of economic substance in Vanuatu (registered office, board records, Vanuatu bank account, contracts, and payroll evidence). Foreign payors remitting subscription-design fees to the IC must apply source-country treaty analysis; tax relief in the payor's jurisdiction depends on the IC's demonstrable residence, substance, and beneficial-ownership status, not on any Vanuatu treaty entitlement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Vanuatu withholding rate on cross-border royalties and debt interest: 0%. No treaty override is applicable because Vanuatu lacks a relevant comprehensive DTA. In the payor jurisdiction, royalty and interest payments remain subject to that jurisdiction's domestic and treaty withholding rules; the IC should expect to provide substance, residence, and beneficial-ownership documentation to reduce or eliminate foreign withholding.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold (VUV 0). Vanuatu has not enacted transfer-pricing legislation and does not mandate Local Files, Master Files, or Country-by-Country Reports. As a prudential OECD-aligned benchmark, contemporaneous arm's-length documentation is recommended whenever the IC's related-party cross-border flows exceed VUV 60,000,000 (approximately USD 500,000) per annum, covering the group structure, functional and risk analysis, intercompany contracts, benchmark studies, and board governance records for subscription-design fees and intercompany licence fees.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations on the BVI/Cayman model, and an IC is not statutorily required to maintain design staff, premises, or board meetings in Vanuatu. The enforceable substance baseline derives from the International Companies Act and the Beneficial Ownership Act: a licensed registered agent, a physical registered office, annual returns, and a current BOR. Foreign tax authorities applying the place-of-effective-management and permanent-establishment concepts will nonetheless examine where the creative workforce, contract negotiation, delivery systems, client relationships, and bank mandates actually sit; an invoice-only IC with no corresponding operational substance is presumptively vulnerable to reclassification as tax-resident in the shareholder's jurisdiction, with full attribution of the subscription revenue to that jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion through sham invoicing and source-country General Anti-Abuse Rule exposure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Directing the IC's recurring UI/UX design-subscription revenue through Vanuatu while all creative staff, contract negotiation, onboarding, delivery platforms, and bank mandates are located in the shareholder's residence country; invoicing the foreign parent without economic justification; absence of any genuine commercial purpose for the Vanuatu billing interposition.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterisation by the foreign tax authority as a sham or artificial scheme: full attribution of the IC's profits to the controlling shareholder, recomputation of tax at the foreign rate, late-payment interest, and penalties often reaching 100%-200% of the tax assessed. Vanuatu cooperates through TIEAs and the OECD Multilateral Convention, and the IC's banking, nominee, and beneficial-ownership records are discoverable through lawful request.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face veil-piercing where the IC is used for fraud or evasion: civil restitution of diverted profits, freezing orders, and travel bans in the shareholder's jurisdiction; criminal prosecution for tax evasion may attach to the individual controlling the IC notwithstanding the IC's zero-tax status in Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC purely as a billing shell: no board meetings, no written director resolutions, no separately administered bank account, no delivery capability for the design work, and the registered agent used solely for mail forwarding; foreign or VFSC scrutiny exposes the absence of any real economic activity connected to Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu law imposes no domestic economic-substance penalty, but the IC faces administrative consequences: VFSC supervisory action under its AML/CFT mandate, refusal of annual registration renewal, and strike-off with loss of limited-liability protection. Foreign revenue authorities may treat the IC as a resident or transparent vehicle and reassess profits to the date of incorporation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly certify the annual return while the company operates as a letterbox commit a false-declaration offence: fines of up to VUV 500,000 and imprisonment of up to six months under the International Companies Act; in the foreign matrix, controlling directors may be assessed personally as the alter ego of the shell.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing design-subscription receivables through payment intermediaries (Stripe Billing, Wise) to obscure the IC's UBO, commingling client funds with personal accounts, issuing fictitious 'consulting' or 'royalty' payments to extract profit, or refusing source-of-funds due-diligence requests from payment acquirers, banks, or VFSC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Proceeds of Crime Act (Cap. 240) criminalises money laundering and provides for asset-confiscation orders and imprisonment of up to 10 years for individuals, with corporate penalties of up to VUV 500,000; the Financial Dealerships Act licensing framework and global AML evaluations impose mandatory suspicious-transaction reporting and customer due-diligence obligations on the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors controlling the payment rails or signing declarations in furtherance of the scheme face personal criminal liability: fines, confiscation of the subscription revenue, and disgorgement; the corporate veil is pierced where the IC is proved to be the instrument of laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using bearer instruments or undisclosed nominee shareholders, delaying BOR disclosure beyond the 14-day event window, omitting the true sponsor of the design-subscription business, or allowing the registered agent to sign client invoices on the IC's behalf without written authority.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Beneficial Ownership Act 2020 imposes fines of up to VUV 500,000 on the company and up to VUV 1,000,000 and two years' imprisonment on each officer in default; VFSC may reject the annual return, suspend the IC's status, and strike the company off the register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors who execute declarations without verifying the true controller are personally liable for misrepresentation: civil disgorgement of all fees received, directors' disqualification orders, travel bans, and criminal imprisonment on conviction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Misrepresentation and fraud against VFSC and financial counterparties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly submitting false annual-return data, forged director consents, backdated share transfers, or misrepresenting the IC's licence and ownership status to payment processors and corporate banks to obtain merchant-of-record facilities for the subscription platform.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fraud provisions of the Vanuatu Penal Code and the International Companies Act render the IC and its officers liable to fines of up to VUV 500,000 and imprisonment of up to six months; merchant acquirers and banks will additionally terminate accounts, reverse chargebacks, file suspicious-activity reports, and accelerate regulatory enforcement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil liability to claw back diverted subscription revenues together with contractual damages to counterparties; criminal exposure attaches directly to the controlling director, who cannot rely on the IC's separate legal personality where the fraud is the director's own act; travel bans and refusal of any Vanuatu residence-related endorsement follow upon conviction.
